sources.openrouter-reasoning: https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/best-practices/reasoning-tokens (reasoning: {effort}; models that only take a token budget get the effort turned into a share of max_tokens)
sources.google-openai-compat: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/openai (reasoning_effort minimal/low/medium/high/none; Gemini 2.5 Pro and 3 cannot be turned off)
sources.qwen-model-card: https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B (thinking is the default; chat_template_kwargs {enable_thinking: false} turns it off; 32,768 output tokens recommended for most queries, 81,920 for the hardest)
sources.deepseek-v41-model-card: https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (its chat template, read 2026-10-14: kwargs thinking_mode "thinking"|"chat" default "thinking" (enable_thinking is an alias); reasoning_effort an integer 1-100 or low/medium/high/max, default "high", the template's own map low 50 / medium 62 / high 75 / max 100) and https://recipes.vllm.ai/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (read 2026-10-14: chat_template_kwargs {thinking, reasoning_effort}; low 25 / high 50 / xhigh 75 / max 100 or an integer 1-100; "medium" and "minimal" rejected; the page says the DeepSeek API maps low/high/max to 50/75/100 while the open-source encoder, and so vLLM, maps low/high/xhigh/max to 25/50/75/100, so "high" runs at 50 there, with both keys unset thinking is ON at effort 50). THE TWO SOURCES DISAGREE on what "high" is (75 vs 50) and on the default, and Together's own reasoning page (docs.together.ai/docs/inference/chat/reasoning.md, read 2026-10-14) does NOT list V4.1 Flash (it shows chat_template_kwargs {thinking: true} passed through for Qwen3.5), so which map Together applies, and that it passes these kwargs for this id, is NOT established; the form is inferred from the model's template, defaultEffort is left null on purpose DECISION (C&C 14 Oct 2026): the shipped seat sends the INTEGER 75 inside chat_template_kwargs, not the word: 75 is "high" on the template's map and on the DeepSeek API's map and equals vLLM's "xhigh", so it is high or above on every map read here; Together's API reference types the TOP-LEVEL reasoning_effort as an enum of low/medium/high and types chat_template_kwargs as an untyped object, so the integer goes inside chat_template_kwargs. `highAtLeast` (75) on the row is the number from which an integer counts as high; a row without it treats every integer as a lowering.
sources.deepseek-v4-recipe: https://recipes.vllm.ai/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash (chat_template_kwargs {thinking: true, reasoning_effort: "high"|"max"}; the same `thinking` switch the shipped chains used, set to false, on Together; the page is vLLM's serving recipe, Together's own page was not found, so the on-value is not confirmed on Together)
sources.zai-thinking: https://docs.z.ai/guides/capabilities/thinking-mode (thinking: {type: enabled|disabled}, no levels; GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-FLASH forced on)

anthropic-effort.note: thinking stays adaptive (the default on claude-sonnet-5 and claude-opus-5); never "disabled"

budget.rule: half of the seat's output cap, at least 1024, below max_tokens

anthropic-budget.note: claude-haiku-4-5 has no effort levels; "high" there is thinking on with a budget; the seat's cap is raised so that cap = old cap + budget

qwen-template-thinking.note: Together serves Qwen3.5 with the model's own chat-template switch; on is the model default, written out so a chain says it

deepseek-v41-template-thinking.note: DeepSeek V4.1 chat-template switch with an INTEGER effort (1-100): 75 is "high" on the template's and the DeepSeek API's maps and "xhigh" on vLLM's; the row's highAtLeast says from which number an integer counts as high

deepseek-template-thinking.note: DeepSeek V4 chat-template switch; "high" is Think High ("max" is the model's own top mode)

zai-thinking.note: on/off only: the one setting this provider has, so "high" means on
